name: BTC regime: long in bull, half short in bear

hypothesis: Technical analysis on the whole market - when to be in, how much, when to be short - carries the edge in crypto; which coins to hold is second order.
data: point-in-time top-14 lists, daily BTC/ETH closes read at the last close before each 4h decision
